breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface, whereas in reality it is maximal there. The generated specification correctly computes the torsional shear stress τ in part (b) and then uses it in part (c) as τxy = τ in the plane stress analysis, computing principal stresses using both σ and τ. There is no statement anywhere in the generated output that the torsional shear stress vanishes, matching the ground truth's treatment.
